items.title: Gucci previews Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera collection in Manila
items.summary: Gucci showcased its Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera collection at Greenbelt 4, Makati on July 31, presenting fluid tailoring, body-aware silhouettes, shearling layers and an updated Bamboo 1947 bag. Filipino celebrities Marian Rivera, Kyle Echarri, Brent Manalo, Kylie Verzosa, Michelle Dee, BJ Pascual and Bella Racelis attended, styled in curated looks. Coverage framed the collection as moving from daywear ease to evening glamour under creative director Demna.

items.title: L'Oreal H1 2026 results highlight Gucci 50-year beauty license win
items.summary: Thai business press covered L'Oreal Group's first-half 2026 results (group growth ~6.5%), reporting that L'Oreal secured a 50-year exclusive worldwide beauty and fragrance license for Gucci from Kering (taking over early from Coty, effective mid-2027), alongside plans to launch four new brands in the Thai market within the year. The story situates Gucci's licensing shift within a broader regional growth narrative for L'Oreal Luxe.

items.title: Hanoi warehouse raid uncovers thousands of counterfeit Gucci, D&G garments
items.summary: Vietnamese authorities raided an industrial-zone warehouse in Ninh Hiep, Hanoi, seizing roughly 2,575 counterfeit garments bearing Gucci, D&G, Louis Vuitton, Dior, Nike and Adidas logos. A 22-year-old suspect from Bac Ninh had been buying informal bulk clothing stock and reselling pieces with small margins; goods lacked any proof of legitimate origin and the case has been referred for intellectual-property infringement charges. The June 23 inspection result was reported August 5.
